crossRefs.note: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by…
Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion…
If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up…
Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
The king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them…
For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go…
For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

translations.web: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.
translations.bsb: I composed myself until the morning. Like a lion He breaks all my bones; from day until night You make an end of me.
translations.kjv: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end
translations.asv: I quieted myself until morning; as a lion, so he breaketh all my bones: From day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
